{{Quote|Meet with my apprentice, Dri'kill Ba'al. He's my covert operative in Grathan's compound. Ba'al claims to have made a key discovery.|[[Darth Baras]]|<ref name="TOR:LW" />}}
'''Dri'kill Ba'al''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] who was one of [[Darth Baras]]'s several [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentices]] as a part of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] on the Sith capital [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|I thought I might be your only apprentice. That makes Ba'al my rival.|[[Empire's Wrath|Darth Baras's apprentice]]|<ref name="TOR:LW" />}}
During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], Baras sent him to infiltrate the [[Lord Grathan's estate|estate]] of the rebellious [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Grathan]] which he successfully did and located the [[Sith/Legends|Sith's]] greatest weakness, his son [[Beelzlit Grathan]].<ref name="TOR:LW" />

Baras sent an extraordinarily strong [[Empire's Wrath|Sith Warrior]] to Grathan's estate to kill Beelzlit. Upon meeting his rival, Ba'al dismissed the Warrior as nothing more than a simple savage before sending the Warrior on their mission. When the Warrior returned, Ba'al decided that he must kill his rival to solidify his cover and alerted the estate guards. Unfortunately for Ba'al, he proved no match for the Warrior, who quickly slew him.<ref name="TOR:LW" />
